description: Search the public catalog of sites Poacher can watch. Returns each source’s name, category, status (fixture_available or planned) and current availability. A listed source still needs the exact search previewed (quote_preview) before anyone pays for monitoring. No sign-in.

query.description: Words to match in a source’s name, category or description, for example "rare books" or "eBay". Omit to list every source.

name: list_sources

availability.description: temporarily_unavailable means a confirmed outage: new alerts cannot use this source until it is restored. Existing alerts keep their settings. One of: "normal", "temporarily_unavailable".

title: Find Poacher sources
